description: Add two integration scenarios using real Workflows, RunAgent, GetDocument, AttachDocuments, NotifyPerson and channel adapters; stub only LLM HTTP and delivery HTTP/SMTP. Action reuse assessment: reuse these existing Actions and Workflows public lifecycle. No production operations changed. Preserve actor authorization and signed Records; assert exact filename/bytes and Mattermost uploaded file ID or email MIME attachment. Existing assertions unchanged. Browser E2E unnecessary: transport integration directly proves requested behavior. Source inspection identifies RunAgent dropping Outgoing.attachments and NotifyPerson/Notifications lacking attachment propagation; tests must require successful delivery and expose the gap, not inject attachments. No property test needed for these two concrete scenarios.

comments.text: Originally reproduced text-only delivery in both transports. User authorized fix. Both original transport assertions now pass without weakening expectations. Four added denial journeys pass for revoked or absent actors. Fix tracked in zaq-85t and zaq-98k; final validation in progress.

title: Test workflow RunAgent attachment delivery to Mattermost and email
